name: Launch Agent
description: An AI agent that turns one prompt into a full coin: name, logo, website and launch, done in a minute.
whatIf: What if one prompt launched your whole coin?

name: Guard Agent
description: Reads every transaction before you sign it and blocks drainers, fake approvals and bad links.
whatIf: What if your wallet checked every signature for you?

name: Swap Agent
description: Type 'swap half my SOL to USDC' and the agent finds the best route and does it.
whatIf: What if swapping was just one sentence?

name: Whale Agent
description: Follows the top Solana wallets and pings you the second they buy, sell or bridge.
whatIf: What if you saw every whale move first?

name: Airdrop Agent
description: Finds every airdrop your wallet qualifies for and does the tasks for you.
whatIf: What if an agent farmed airdrops while you slept?

name: Gas Agent
description: Times your transactions and sets the cheapest priority fee that still lands fast.
whatIf: What if you never overpaid gas again?

name: Dev Check
description: Paste any coin and the agent scores its dev wallet: past launches, rugs, holds and sells.
whatIf: What if every dev came with a report card?

name: Alpha Inbox
description: Reads hundreds of alpha groups and X accounts and sends you one short digest a day.
whatIf: What if all the alpha fit in one message?

name: Copy Agent
description: Copies the trades of wallets you pick, with your own size limits and stop rules.
whatIf: What if the best wallets traded for you?

name: Yield Agent
description: Moves your idle stablecoins to the best safe yield on Solana, checked every hour.
whatIf: What if your idle USDC never slept?

name: Voice Agent
description: Check balances, swap and send just by talking. Your wallet, voice controlled.
whatIf: What if you could talk to your wallet?

name: Tax Agent
description: Turns your whole wallet history into a clean, ready-to-file tax report.
whatIf: What if crypto taxes took one click?
